question: Which of the following will be the value of (cot x-tan x)/(cot 2x) ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Put x = 30°

⇒ cot 30° = √3, tan 30° = 1/√3, cot(2 × 30°) = cot 60° = 1/√3

⇒ Numerator = √3 − 1/√3 = (3 − 1)/√3 = 2/√3

⇒ Denominator = 1/√3

⇒ Expression = (2/√3) ÷ (1/√3) = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression: (cot x − tan x) / cot 2x

**Formula Used:**

cot x = cos x / sin x

tan x = sin x / cos x

cos²x − sin²x = cos 2x

2 sin x cos x = sin 2x

cot 2x = cos 2x / sin 2x

**Calculations:**

⇒ Numerator = cot x − tan x

⇒ Numerator = (cos x / sin x) − (sin x / cos x)

⇒ Numerator = (cos²x − sin²x) / (sin x cos x)

⇒ Numerator = cos 2x / (sin x cos x)

⇒ Multiply numerator and denominator by 2:

⇒ Numerator = 2 cos 2x / (2 sin x cos x)

⇒ Numerator = 2 cos 2x / sin 2x

⇒ Numerator = 2 cot 2x

⇒ Now, substitute this back into the given expression:

⇒ Expression = 2 cot 2x / cot 2x = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Double Angle Identity for Tangent

tan 2x = 2 tan x / (1 − tan²x). This is widely used in trigonometric simplifications.

Double Angle Identity for Sine

sin 2x = 2 sin x cos x = 2 tan x / (1 + tan²x)

Double Angle Identity for Cosine

cos 2x = cos²x − sin²x = 2 cos²x − 1 = 1 − 2 sin²x = (1 − tan²x) / (1 + tan²x)
